cli.description: GenuineCI command-line tool for managing CI/CD and secrets.

login.description: Log in to GenuineCI server (Local or Cloud).

flags.local: Log in to local Docker environment (http://localhost:8080).
flags.profile: Profile name to store credentials under.

use.description: Set the default display language (japanese, english).
use.invalidLanguage: Invalid language "${input}". Supported languages: japanese, english.

dev.description: Manage local development environment (Docker, Tart, DB, Server).

start.description: Start local services and run the Mac Orchard Worker until Ctrl+C.

flags.seed: Queue one build job after starting services. Requires --repo, --commit-sha, --workflow and --installation-id.
flags.commitSha: Full 40-character commit SHA available on GitHub (required with --seed).
flags.workflow: Dart workflow path relative to genuine_ci/, e.g. worker_smoke.dart (required with --seed).
flags.installationId: Positive GitHub App installation ID (required with --seed; mock ID 12345678 is not supported).
flags.branch: Branch name for the seeded job's metadata (with --seed).
